title.zh: 将南苏里高省 Hinatuan 市镇 Biga-An 描笼涯的 Tagasaka 国立中学附属校分离，改设为独立的 Biga-An 国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Tagasaka National High School - Biga-An Annex in Barangay Biga-An, Municipality of Hinatuan, Province of Surigao Del Sur From the Tagasaka National High School. Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as Biga-An National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Biga-An của Trường Trung học Tagasaka Quốc gia tại Barangay Biga-An, Đô thị Hinatuan, Tỉnh Surigao Del Sur khỏi Trường Trung học Tagasaka Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Biga-An Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Biga-An ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Tagasaka แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Biga-An เทศบาล Hinatuan จังหวัด Surigao Del Sur ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Tagasaka แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Biga-An แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Biga-An, Sekolah Menengah Tagasaka Nasional di Barangay Biga-An, Kotamadya Hinatuan, Provinsi Surigao Del Sur dari Sekolah Menengah Tagasaka Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Biga-An Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Biga-An, Sekolah Menengah Tagasaka Kebangsaan di Barangay Biga-An, Perbandaran Hinatuan, Wilayah Surigao Del Sur daripada Sekolah Menengah Tagasaka Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Biga-An Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into an Independent National High School. – The Tagasaka National High School – Biga-an Annex in Barangay Biga-an, Municipality of Hinatuan, Province of Surigao del Sur is hereby separated from the Tagasaka National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Biga-an National High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. – All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Tagasaka National High School – Biga-an Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Biga-an National High School.

Appropriations. – The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Biga-an National High School the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriation of the Tagasaka National High School – Biga-an Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. – The Secretary of Education shall issue rules and regulations that may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. – This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
